-- Best-effort rollback for course schema refactor
-- NOTE: Per-version localized texts cannot be fully restored; we copy course_i18n into current/default versions.
BEGIN;

-- Restore legacy columns
ALTER TABLE course ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compose_config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;

ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS title varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS description text;
ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tech_label varchar(64);
ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS main_tech varchar(64);
ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS main_tech_version varchar(32);

-- Recreate course_version_i18n
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_version_i18n (
    course_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_version_id, i18n_id)
);

-- Backfill course.compose_config from current (or latest) version's compose_config
WITH picked AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS course_id,
        cv.compose_config_id
    FROM course c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cv.compose_config_id
        FROM course_version cv
        WHERE cv.course_id = c.id
        ORDER BY (cv.id = c.current_version_id) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.version DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) cv ON TRUE
)
UPDATE course c
SET compose_config = COALESCE(cc.config, '{}'::jsonb)
FROM picked p
LEFT JOIN compose_config cc ON cc.id = p.compose_config_id
WHERE c.id = p.course_id;

-- Backfill course_version title/description from course_i18n (prefer 'en', else any)
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ci.course_id,
        ci.title,
        ci.description,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ci.course_id
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.language = 'en' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.language
        ) AS rn
    FROM course_i18n ci
    JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ci.i18n_id
)
UPDATE course_version cv
SET title = r.title,
    description = r.description
FROM ranked r
WHERE cv.course_id = r.course_id AND r.rn = 1;

-- Backfill tech labels from course.main_tech_id
UPDATE course_version cv
SET tech_label = t.label,
    main_tech = t.label
FROM course c
JOIN tech t ON t.id = c.main_tech_id
WHERE cv.course_id = c.id AND (cv.tech_label IS NULL OR cv.tech_label = '');

-- Ensure required legacy columns are not null (fallback to empty strings)
UPDATE course_version SET title = '' WHERE title IS NULL;
UPDATE course_version SET description = '' WHERE description IS NULL;
UPDATE course_version SET tech_label = '' WHERE tech_label IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE course_version ALTER COLUMN title SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_version ALTER COLUMN description SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_version ALTER COLUMN tech_label SET NOT NULL;

-- Recreate course_version_i18n from course_i18n for current/default versions
INSERT INTO course_version_i18n (course_version_id, i18n_id, title, description)
SELECT c.current_version_id, ci.i18n_id, ci.title, ci.description
FROM course c
JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = c.id
WHERE c.current_version_id IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO course_version_i18n (course_version_id, i18n_id, title, description)
SELECT cv.id, ci.i18n_id, ci.title, ci.description
FROM course_version cv
JOIN course c ON c.id = cv.course_id
JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = c.id
WHERE cv.is_default = true
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

-- Drop new constraints and columns
ALTER TABLE course DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_main_tech;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_version_compose_config;

ALTER TABLE course DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS main_tech_id;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS compose_config_id;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS compose_config_tech;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS course_tech;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS course_i18n;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS compose_config;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tech;

COMMIT;
